title: Timmy's School Play Triumph
content: Timmy truly shone during the school play at Greenwood Elementary, where he played the lead role. His performance was not only a testament to his talent but also to the support he receives from his family. Both his moms, Jane and her partner, as well as Ex-Hubby Mark, were in attendance, demonstrating a united front for Timmy's special day.

title: Detailed Co-parenting Schedule and Decision-Making
content: The co-parenting schedule agreed upon by Jane, her partner, and Ex-Hubby Mark includes alternating weekends and a midweek visit for Timmy. Mark picks Timmy up from school on Fridays and drops him off on Sunday evenings. During summer and winter breaks, the schedule adjusts to allow for extended time with each parent. Decisions regarding Timmy's education, health, and welfare are made in a collaborative manner. Monthly meetings are held to discuss Timmy's progress and any adjustments needed to the co-parenting plan. Emergency decisions are communicated through a shared digital platform, ensuring all parties are informed and can provide input in a timely manner. Special occasions like birthdays and holidays are planned in advance, with the parents alternating hosting duties each year. This detailed plan has been developed with the help of a family counselor to ensure that Timmy's well-being is at the forefront of all decisions.
